results.title: Tarapith Hotel Fire Tragedy: 8 Killed, Several Injured; Owner Arrested
results.description: Eight people, mostly pilgrims, were killed and several injured after a fire broke out at a four-storey hotel in Tarapith, Birbhum, around 5 am on Monday. Firefighters used 22 tenders to douse the blaze in nearly three hours. Police arrested hotel owner Kalyan Paul and launched a probe into the cause of the fire and whether adequate safety measures were in place.

results.title: Wallet-friendly, corporate-level medical care: CM on TIMS inauguration
results.description: CM A Revanth Reddy inaugurates 1,082-bed TIMS Sanathnagar in Hyderabad, built for ₹1,126 crore, featuring 37 departments and a 100-bed medical tourism wing.

results.title: In a first, Manipur soldier gets Shaurya Chakra for foiling drone attack
results.description: An army soldier received a gallantry medal for his actions against insurgents. Naib Subedar Shankar Ram was injured while returning fire and spotting a drone. This incident highlights the growing use of armed drones by non-state actors. Insurgents are rigging commercial drones with explosives for attacks. The armed forces are procuring anti-drone systems to counter this threat.
